Don’t be upset if you don’t meet pirates, as the game from 1990 implies. And no pirates here, either. There are several spots to visit: Khu dự trữ sinh quyển thế giới It was part of a school trip from AISVN in 2019 with several classes of grade 9 (I was teaching all of them in Chemistry back then). Well organized, a lot of monkeys. Not that far. And good view from the tower. Google maps: Khu dự trữ sinh quyển thế giới with 102 reviews. Entrance is 100k, the first 500 meter by electric car 25k. Walking 2 kilometers, at the beginning a crocodile farm. Later in the jungle some display of war time history. Motorized canoe back is 80k and takes only 5 minutes.
